note: `models` = the OpenRouter models the probe runs the whole day set on (Tim 2026-11-11), each at reasoning effort medium set in the probe's opencode config. Task set of the agent-side probe (RULING 71; spec specs/agent-probe-opencode.md). The prompt is sent VERBATIM as the user message; no system prompt is added. `core` tasks run every day (comparability); `rotating` tasks run two per day by date. `gold_hosts` = hosts that hold the authoritative answer (a host matches itself and its sub-hosts); empty = no single authority. `knows_already` = a current frontier model answers this correctly from memory (the control: does the harness still search?).
